sourceFirstUnits.requirement: Distinguish a biological HLA-associated peptide repertoire in a specified population/context from the recovered laboratory list.

sourceFirstUnits.requirement: Alleles, source-protein supply, processing, loading and turnover shape the repertoire.

sourceFirstUnits.requirement: A class-I repertoire is neither a class-II census nor a list of all cellular proteins.

sourceFirstUnits.requirement: Whole-cell HLA recovery can include surface and intracellular complexes, so the compartment claim must be specified.

sourceFirstUnits.sourceExcerpt: Recovery, dissociation/separation and identification are distinct.
